meta.description: Governance decisions defining the selected launch configuration. Requirements whose applicability depends on an 'undecided' value render decision-needed on the dashboard, never blocked or not-required. If a decision later excludes a requirement because a feature is disabled, the exclusion should reference technical enforcement evidence in the evidence map before being treated as final.
meta.governance: Only Scot changes the decisions in this file. Scripts and agents never flip a decision value; they only read it.
